results.name: W1 empty text has zero counts
W2 spaces, blank paragraphs and CRLF do not inflate words or character totals
W3 apostrophes, hyphens, decomposed accents and emoji count as reader-visible characters
W4 long input stays bounded and preserves linear counts
W5 selection-style input: same tokenizer on a substring, whitespace and punctuation edges
W6 grapheme clusters: emoji ZWJ sequences and combining marks count as one reader-visible character
W7 tabs and form feeds separate words like spaces; only newlines split lines
W8 line and paragraph boundaries: trailing newline ends the last line, adds no paragraph
W9 internal combining marks stay one word and CJK Unified Ideographs count per ideograph
W10 model-aware countWordDoc excludes tracked deletions, inline images, and deleted table rows
W11 countWordDoc and countWordRange handle footnotes, endnotes, deleted paragraph marks and multi-cell selections
W12 round-trip .docx differential against independent python-docx + Python grapheme/word oracle
